name: Cafe Angelika
kurzbeschreibung: **Welcome to Café Angelika in Tirol!** Nestled in the heart of the **Alpenland**, our cozy café invites you to indulge in the finest **Tiroler** hospitality. Whether you're seeking a warm cup of coffee, a slice of freshly baked **Apfelstrudel**, or a hearty serving of **Kaiserschmarrn**, we promise an unforgettable experience. Just a short stroll from the bustling center of **Innsbruck**, we offer a perfect retreat for travelers and locals alike. Savor the flavors of **Tirol** while enjoying the breathtaking views of the **Nordkette** or the charming streets of the old town. Come visit us and let the warmth of **Tirol** wrap around you! ☕️🍰 --- **Opening Hours:** - **Monday–Friday:** 7:30 AM – 6:00 PM - **Saturday:** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM - **Sunday:** 8:30 AM – 4:00 PM **Specialties:** - **Tiroler Grüner Veltliner** (local wine) - **Käsekrainer** (cheesy sausage) - **Topfenstrudel** (quark strudel) - **Vanillekipferl** (vanilla crescent cookies) --- **Location:** --- **Follow us for updates:** 📷 Instagram | 🐦 Twitter | 📘 Facebook
